description: This file is a C++ source code implementing a WebClient class that interacts with a web server using secure sockets, handling HTTP requests, responses, and authorization. It includes main function logic for user interaction to connect, disconnect, and send requests.

classes.name: WebClient
classes.description: A class that manages secure WebSocket connections, sending HTTP requests, handling responses, and managing connection states.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a text body to the response when a partial request is received.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Handles the reception of a response, printing its contents.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a request and prints the request data.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles changes in connection state, printing status messages.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Creates and submits a GET request to a predefined URL.

methods.name: SubmitAuthRequest
methods.description: Creates and submits an authenticated GET request with Basic auth.
